name: Standard (x32)
script_install:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

install -d -m 0770 /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /tmp
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

export HOME=/mnt/server
export LANG=C.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
STEAMCMD=/mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 1/3: Updating SteamCMD"
"$STEAMCMD" +login anonymous +quit || true

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 2/3: Downloading GMod Windows files"
"$STEAMCMD" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 4020 validate +quit

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 3/3: Downloading GMod Linux files"
"$STEAMCMD" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 4020 validate +quit

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/srcds_run ]; then
    echo "[Atlas] Error: SteamCMD completed without installing srcds_run." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "[Atlas] Finalizing 32-bit Steam libraries..."
install -D -m 0644 /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
install -D -m 0644 /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/bin/steamclient.so
find /mnt/server -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "srcds*" -exec chmod u+x {} +
